SELECT json_build_object(
  'digest_summary', (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json)
    FROM (
      SELECT date_berlin, new_leads_count, high_signal_leads_count, active_pipeline_leads_count, new_persons_count, new_linkedin_connections_count, new_substack_subscribers_count, daily_activities_count, total_leads_cumulative, total_persons_cumulative, total_companies_cumulative, total_activities_cumulative, high_priority_leads, daily_activities_json, calculated_at_berlin
      FROM s_motherduck.sum_cdp_weekly_network_digest
      ORDER BY date_berlin DESC
      LIMIT 14
    ) t
  ),
  'high_priority_leads', (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json)
    FROM (
      SELECT lead_id, full_name, description, intent, signal_strength, opportunity_type, status, summary, lead_stage_name, intake_at_berlin
      FROM s_motherduck.cdp_leads
      WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(signal_strength, '')) IN ('HIGH', 'HOT', 'STRONG')
         OR UPPER(COALESCE(lead_stage_slug, '')) IN ('NEW', 'QUALIFIED', 'PROSPECT')
      ORDER BY intake_at_berlin DESC
      LIMIT 20
    ) t
  ),
  'recent_activities', (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json)
    FROM (
      SELECT activity_id, title, activity_type, summary_or_content, to_dos, activity_date_berlin
      FROM s_motherduck.cdp_activities
      ORDER BY activity_date_berlin DESC
      LIMIT 20
    ) t
  ),
  'key_contacts', (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json)
    FROM (
      SELECT person_id, full_name, primary_email, primary_phone, linkedin_url, primary_company_name, engagement_temperature, created_at_berlin
      FROM s_motherduck.cdp_persons
      ORDER BY created_at_berlin DESC
      LIMIT 20
    ) t
  )
) AS data;
